0.0: Hello. I heard everything #p2032001# and you talked about from the side. #bSpiruna#k's precious #bBlack Crystal#k looks terrible. I understand how you feel, but no words will make Spiruna feel better at the moment.\r\n#L0# #bWhat should I do?#l\n#k
0.1: I can give you a hint if you do me a favor. So, will you do me a favor? It could make Spiruna feel a whole lot better...

yes.0: Good. Please defeat #r40#k of each type of #rPixie#k pushing their way through Orbis. Don't let their looks fool you. They're a menace to Orbis and need to be eradicated.

no.0: Didn't you have business with Spiruna?

1.0: Your efforts will slow the inevitable. We owe you thanks.
1.1: Huh? Why am I so happy? Well, those #rPixies#k are a big threat to #rOrbis#k. Now there's less of them. Of course I'm happy about that.
1.2: Huh? You don't believe me? ...Well, believe whatever you like. Let's just talk about #bhow to fix Spiruna's Black Crystal#k. That's what you're here for, right?

mob.0: I did ask you to take out a whole lot of pixies. I'm sure it'll take a while.
